In today's Daily Fix:
Take-Two's CEO Strauss Zelnick claimed in an interview that preorders for the $100 Ultimate Edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 is outselling the standard $80 edition. Pricing varies depending on which version of the PS5 you choose. And finally, Halloween: The Game has been refused classification in Australia and won't be sold in New Zealand. This is reportedly due to drug use in the game.

author: IGN
description:
Big Walk reviewed by Nicole Carpenter on PC, also available on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

"Big Walk is full of beautiful emergent moments as you find solutions to cleverly built puzzles and adventure between them in its vast open world. Falling down a mountain at night and scrambling to find your dropped gear, finding your friends from a flare in the distance, or developing the language to both name things in its world and build a process to figure out its most complex puzzles is all part of the magic that makes Big Walk unlike any other co-op game. The myriad ways it pushes you and your friends, placing limitations that test your problem solving in ways as challenging as they are charming – that’s what defines this experience. But that intrinsic reward of freeing the next red bean to put it in its place atop the next big bean tower is just as special."

#ign #gaming #bigwalk
title: Big Walk Review

author: IGN
description:
Here's your look at the Job Simulator: Human Relations announcement trailer for this upcoming officially licensed flat-screen co-op physics comedy game from FarBridge (the studio behind Homeworld: Vast Reaches and credits in RWBY Grimm Eclipse), developed in collaboration with IP holder Owlchemy Labs. 

Set in 2050, after human employment has been completely terminated, Job Simulator: Human Relations takes players back to the Museum of Human Employment for its latest living-history exhibit. The robot curators behind it learned everything they know about office life from social media posts, corporate training videos, and toxic productivity gurus. Needless to say, their recreation of work is…not accurate. 

Job Simulator: Human Relations will be available on PC. A Kickstarter campaign is out now.
title: Job Simulator: Human Relations - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Official Trailer for Verity, an upcoming psychological thriller distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Witness a seductive and thrilling narrative in Verity, in theaters on October 2.

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. Verity is produced by Nick Antosca, Alex Hedlund, Stacey Sher, Michael Showalter, Jordana Mollick, Anne Hathaway, and Colleen Hoover.

Verity, directed by Michael Showalter, opens in theaters on October 2, 2026.
title: Verity - Official Trailer (2026) Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett
